messages:
jia: Heads-up — we've seen a small spike in reconnects from streaming clients since last deploy, and a couple customers reported duplicate token billing. Console shows a short cost blip around 08:42 UTC.
kevin: Which route / region? rough numbers?
jia: Mostly prod edge (us-west). ~120 reconnects/min for a 3m window, duplicate token count ~0.4% of total tokens.
ops-bot: [ALERT] StreamReconnectRate (us-west) > 100/min at 1761112222
sasha: I can see the timeline on the streaming dashboard — sticky-route eviction jumps at 08:41:55, followed by resume attempts. Possible race between sticky lease TTL and proxy fence.
maria: Could be the proxy sending 204 to force resubscribe while resume id is still valid? If resume fails, client falls back and reconsumes tokens.
dave: Can we add stronger idempotency on resume? e.g., server should check X-Resume-ID + session-epoch and return 200+no-charge if duplicate.
kevin: +1. Also need better telemetry: emit resume_attempt with resume_id and charge_bool to trace billing duplication.
jia: Quick debug commands I ran:
```
kubectl -n streaming logs -l app=proxy --since=10m | grep resume | tail -n 50
```
sample log extract:
```
[08:41:56] proxy-7c8 resume_request id=abc123 session=shard-12 result=accepted
[08:41:56] proxy-7c8 fence_release session=shard-12 lease=expired
[08:41:57] upstream-1 resume_request id=abc123 charge=true
```
kevin: that looks like a fence-release -> immediate resume accepted path, but upstream still billed. Might be ordering in the service that routes to billing emitter.
sasha: UX ask: console rollout page currently hides resume_attempt counts behind aggregation. We should add a per-route "resume idempotency failures" metric on the streaming console. Also add an alert when duplicate_charge_rate > 0.1% for 5m.
maria: Proposed action: 1) quick fix: bump sticky lease TTL by 5s in proxy canary to reduce race 2) mid fix: server-side resume idempotency check + idempotency metric 3) telemetry + dashboard update 4) canary rollout 10% for 30m 5) postmortem if persists
kevin: I'm happy to own the canary bump. I'll open a PR for proxy config and add a feature flag. Plan: roll for 10% of us-west for 30m, watch resume_attempt and duplicate_charge metrics.
dave: For the server change I'll prototype an idempotency table with TTL=10m and emit a resume_idempotency_event. Will open PR.
jia: Can we also add a console card showing resume vs fallback counts? Sasha can you sketch where?
sasha: Yep, will add a small widget under streaming->routes with sparkline + anomaly markers. Will also add a link to the logs with pre-filled query: `source=proxy AND resume_id=...`
kevin: Thanks. Ops-bot backs up: deploying proxy-canary v2 in 5m :rocket:
ops-bot: [DEPLOY] Started canary deployment proxy-canary-us-west v2 at 1761112422
jia: 👍 keep me posted, if spike persists we'll abort and rollback.
kevin: will DM infra runbook if we need to roll back.
maria: added the telemetry ticket: STREAM-4567
dave: added server PR: https://git/redwood/streaming/+/789
sasha: dashboard ticket: DASH-981
kevin: update: canary at 10% up, watching metrics...
ops-bot: [DEPLOY] Canary 10% healthy at 1761112480 :white_check_mark:
kevin: early numbers look good, duplicate_charge_rate dropped to 0.05% in canary shard
jia: great, keep monitoring for 1h, then increase to 50% if stable :thumbsup:
